statement: Each of the services, nodes and replica_operations system tables has one decoder module (<table>-row-decoder.js exporting decode<Table>Row) that turns a stored-shape row into a frozen canonical object with named states: closed domains (services status and raft_role, nodes status and connection_state, replica_operations type, status and workflow_step) refuse an unknown stored value, SQL NULL decodes to a named absent state, a column the row lacks is a typed refusal, and a partial SELECT decodes through a named projection declared once beside the query that yields exactly the projection's named fields and a projection marker; the existing per-table normalisers (normalizeServiceRow, normalizeReplicaRow, normalizeCensusServiceRow, normalizeCurrentVoterServiceRow, normalizeNodeRow, the column decoding of ReplicaOperationRepository#rowToOperation, normalizeReplicaOperationRecord, normalizeOperationProgressRecord, readOperationWorkflowRecord, normalizePublicationOperationWorkflowRecord and the routed display normalisers) are folded into the decoders so one version of each decoding exists and their call sites read decoded objects; and the budget gains the measuring rows system_table_raw_column_reads_outside_decoder (reads of a table's own columns outside its decoder and write builders, capped one-way at the measured count) and one row per directory group (rebalancer, control-plane, node, admin, query, partition; target 0) that the system-table-decoded-reads-* quests drive to zero; behaviour is unchanged.

constraints.statement: Only the table's decoder reads its raw column names. A consumer that still does is a violation the detector reports, not an allowed exception.
The decoder shapes the row it was given. It never fetches, caches or defaults a value the row lacks; an absent column is a typed refusal (R05, R07).
The row_field_alias_reads and state_read_defaults baselines are lowered in the same change by the number of sites removed.
The src/ changes land only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
Decoding preserves every value consumers read today under its named field; every expectation change in an existing test is justified against HEAD behaviour with a production-shaped fixture.
